subject: Unexpected availability gap — quantify downtime and next steps for credit
messages:
From: Tara Green <tara.green@paybyte.com>
To: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Cc: account-ops@paybyte.com
Date: Wed, 23 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intermittent 503s during peak checkout — can you confirm downtime window?

Hi Neha,

Hope you're well. We started seeing intermittent 503s hitting our checkout flow this morning around 09:04 PDT and again this afternoon around 14:42 PDT. Our SREs measured elevated error rates and some customers seeing failed payments. We captured a small sample and have a support ticket open (#4531).

Can Redwood confirm whether there was an availability gap on the hosted inference endpoint (model: rwd-raft-v1) between 09:00–09:30 and 14:30–15:00 PDT? We need the official window for our internal incident report and to evaluate SLA credit eligibility.

Attached: logs_sample.txt (small)

Thanks,
Tara
Tara Green
Head of Payments Engineering, PayByte

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Tara Green <tara.green@paybyte.com>
Cc: david.kim@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 23 Sep 2026 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intermittent 503s during peak checkout — can you confirm downtime window?

Hi Tara — thanks for the heads-up and the log sample. I'm pulling the SLO telemetry and kicking off an incident evidence pull with infra.

Quick notes and immediate asks:
- We'll validate service-level telemetry for rwd-raft-v1 and return the precise error-rate windows.
- To speed verification, can you share the tenant id or affected request ids (if available)? The sample helps, but the tenant id lets us correlate traces quickly.
- We'll likely need permission to pull traces and ephemeral traces from the region for up to 72 hours; could you confirm we have OK from PayByte to extract these for the audit?

I've looped in David (runtime ops) and Laura (Customer Success) to help with window verification and next-step coordination. Expect a first pass with metrics + provisional downtime quant in ~2 business hours.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Manager, Redwood Inference
redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, Tara Green <tara.green@paybyte.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Sep 2026 11:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intermittent 503s during peak checkout — can you confirm downtime window?

On Wed, 23 Sep 2026 at 09:45 AM Neha Kapoor wrote:
> I've looped in David (runtime ops) and Laura (Customer Success) to help with window verification and next-step coordination. Expect a first pass with metrics + provisional downtime quant in ~2 business hours.

Tara / Neha — I pulled the telemetry for the tenant and the region (us-west-2). Initial findings:
- Two discrete spikes in 5xx rate for the rwd-raft-v1 serving fleet: 2026-09-23T16:02:00Z — 2026-09-23T16:16:00Z (09:02–09:16 PDT) and 2026-09-23T21:41:00Z — 2026-09-23T21:51:00Z (14:41–14:51 PDT).
- During the first window average success rate for your traffic dropped from 99.987% to 96.2%; the second window averaged 97.4% success.
- We observed ~1.8 minutes of continuous unrecoverable error for a small subset of connections (sticky sessions) during the first spike.

Provisional downtime quantification: if we conservatively treat any minute with aggregated error >1% as impacted for SLA purposes, the combined impacted duration is 24 minutes (14 + 10), with per-tenant weighted availability reduction of ~0.016 percentage points for the 30-day window.

Next steps I propose:
1) Confirm exact request-id list from PayByte so we can build raw trace bundles.
2) Produce a raw trace bundle and metrics snapshot (attaching metrics-snapshot-20260923.csv) and share the temporary download link.
3) The legal/finance team requires a formal credit estimate — I can produce a provisional credit calc after we validate tenant scope.

Notes on eligibility: per your agreement (Section 4.2, Availability), an event must be classified as a Severity 1 availability incident and meet the 99.95% monthly availability threshold to trigger prorated credits. Based on initial numbers this is borderline; we need the exact tenant traffic distribution for the month to finalize.

Attachments: metrics-snapshot-20260923.csv

—David
David Kim
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Tara Green <tara.green@paybyte.com>
Cc: david.kim@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intermittent 503s during peak checkout — quantify downtime and next steps for credit

Hi Tara — following up with the confirmed windows and next steps.

Summary (confirmed):
- Confirmed impacted windows for rwd-raft-v1: 2026-09-23 09:02–09:16 PDT and 2026-09-23 14:41–14:51 PDT.
- Combined impacted duration we will use for an initial credit calculation: 24 minutes.
- Provisional eligibility: borderline under Section 4.2. We can proceed with a formal credit evaluation if PayByte submits a request within the contract windows.

Requested actions from PayByte:
- Please reply with the tenant id and confirm permission for Redwood to extract full traces for the two windows (we'll limit to request ids you provide).
- Confirm whether you want us to schedule a joint postmortem (we recommend a 60-minute working session next week) and whether to include product and runtime engineering.

What Redwood will provide once we have permission:
- Full raw trace bundle for the two windows (encrypted download)
- Provisional credit calc and a short rationale PDF (attached: provisional-credit-calc.pdf)
- Postmortem agenda and a recommended remediation checklist (canary tuning and autoscaler profile updates)

If you approve trace extraction, we'll pull the artifacts and start drafting the formal claim packet for your procurement/legal team.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if you'd prefer to walk through the numbers.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Manager, Redwood Inference
Neha.Kapoor@redwood.ai
Cc: Laura Bennett (CS), David Kim (SRE), Rishi Malhotra (Contracts)
